definitions.gloss: following blindly; tagging along; following suit
definitions.explanation: Following someone or something without independent thought or initiative. Often implies uncritical compliance or imitation.

examples.japanese: {大手|おおて}に{追従|ついじゅう}する。
examples.english: To follow the major companies' lead.

examples.japanese: {他社|たしゃ}の{値下|ねさ}げに{追従|ついじゅう}して{価格|かかく}を{下|さ}げた。
examples.english: We followed other companies' lead and lowered our prices.

examples.japanese: {権力者|けんりょくしゃ}に{追従|ついじゅう}するだけでは、{本当|ほんとう}の{改革|かいかく}はできない。
examples.english: True reform cannot be achieved by merely following those in power.

notes: Used with する to form {追従|ついじゅう}する (to follow, to tag along). Common collocations: {追従|ついじゅう}を{許|ゆる}さない (to be unrivaled, to be beyond compare — literally "not allowing others to follow"). Note: the same kanji {追従|ついしょう} with a different reading means "flattery" or "sycophancy" — a completely different meaning. The reading {追従|ついじゅう} specifically means following/imitating. Related: {追随|ついずい} (following — very close synonym, slightly more formal), {模倣|もほう} (imitation — emphasizes copying).
